{{Top|leg}}
'''Plastiform''' was a packing material. It was blown into a package and would keep the contents safe from sharp movements.

The [[Holo House]] at a funfair in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] lowerlevels contained plastiform walls, which [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] slashed through with her [[Aurra Sing's green lightsaber|lightsaber]] during her confrontation with [[Laranth Tarak]].<ref name="CNII:SOS">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
